name: Space Watch
description: What's passing overhead: a sky dome of the brightest satellites, rocket stages and fresh satellite trains, with plain-language pointing, rewind, the next visible passes, details, a follow mode that turns the dome with your phone and a pointing view that guides the raised phone to a satellite. Positions are computed on the phone; your location is never sent. Requires Construct API 0.14.

capabilities.reason: Download public orbit lists and catalogs from CelesTrak (bright objects and recent launches), and, only when you ask, a short Wikipedia description of the selected object. No location is sent.
Optionally take one foreground location fix when the module opens or when you tap Use my location, to draw the sky from where you are. The fix stays on this phone.
Optionally read the phone's compass and tilt while Follow is on, to turn the sky dome to where you face or guide the raised phone to the selected object. Readings stay on this phone.
Save your start choice, red mode and a few hours of downloaded orbit data, not your location.
